 Midday update: 162,000 voters have cast ballots in North Dakota 
 By VNL Staff Published : Nov. 3, 2026 at 1:36 PM CST | Updated : 7 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google FARGO, N.D. (Valley News Live) - The North Dakota Office of the Secretary of State reports that as of 1:00 pm, 162,000 voters have cast ballots for the 2026 General Election. This is a 27% voter turnout. 
 Voter turnout numbers include absentee, mail, early voting, and Election Day voting. 
 Unofficial election results will be available starting at 8:00 p.m. Election results can be found on the Valley News Live election results page as soon as they become available.
 For information on how to vote in North Dakota and Minnesota, click here . Polls for the midterm election are open until 8 p.m. in Minnesota, 7 p.m. in North Dakota.
